summary: Describes how Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) runs over IPv4 and IPv6 when the two systems are a single IP hop apart. It covers how BFD packets are carried so that two directly connected devices can quickly notice when the path between them stops working. It is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: Two kids on either end of a short string keep tugging it. If the tugs stop, both know right away that the string broke.

questions: how does bfd work over ipv4 and ipv6
